newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to sell 3.23 pct stake in Cemig.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to sell 3.23 pct stake in Cemig.

text.p: Minas Gerais state said on Wednesday it will auction off a 3.23 percent stake in its power utility Cemig.
The state said it will offer 4.2 billion of Cemig preferred shares at an auction at the Minas, Espirito Santo and Brasilia bourse at 1330 local/1630 GMT, according to the published tender documents.
The minimum price was set at 46.06 reais per 1,000 shares, it said.
In 1996, Cemig net profit rose 1.92 percent to 241.5 million reais versus 237 million posted in 1995.
Minas Gerais state together with its investment company Minas Gerais Participacoes hold a 41.7 percent stake in Cemig.
Banco Emblema, Patrimonio, CCF, Real de Investmento, SRL, Concordia, Primus and Vertice will be brokering the deal, it said.
This auction precedes a closely watched sale of a 32.9 percent stake in Cemig to a strategic operator on April 25.
